description: This file defines the JsonBody class responsible for formatting JSON payloads for AWS API requests, specifically handling different shape types and content type headers.

classes.name: JsonBody
classes.description: Handles the serialization of JSON request bodies for AWS API operations, including building and formatting JSON payloads based on the operation's shape.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the JsonBody with an AWS Service object.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Determines the correct Content-Type header for a given AWS service, based on protocol and JSON version.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the JSON body string from a shape and arguments, encoding it properly.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Recursively formats a shape and its value into a structure suitable for JSON serialization, handling different types like structure, list, map, blob, and timestamp.
